analyzed_vuln.description: Heap OOB read in JSON export of VPORT: the VPORT serializer reads a string/buffer field as if it were NUL-terminated and accesses one byte past the allocated region. The backing allocation originates from pre-R13 table decoding (decode_preR13_section), which can produce a non-NUL-terminated 57-byte buffer; later, dwg_json_VPORT_private traverses it past end while formatting JSON.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Fuzzer input is decoded as a pre-R13/R11-style DWG table entry in SECTION_VPORT via decode_preR13_section/decode_preR13, creating a malformed VPORT object with a short/non-terminated text field. When harness llvmfuzz calls dwg_write_json, object dispatch reaches dwg_json_VPORT -> dwg_json_VPORT_private, which emits that field without validating length/termination, triggering a 1-byte read past heap allocation boundary.
